name: @chatovo/client-native
description: Chatovo desktop and Android shell — Tauri 2 wrapping the web client.
author: Alexandr Artemev

scripts.android:build: bun run icon && node ./scripts/setup-android-fcm.mjs && bun --env-file .env tauri android build --apk --aab --target aarch64 --target x86_64
scripts.android:dev: bun run icon && node ./scripts/setup-android-fcm.mjs && bun --env-file .env tauri android dev
scripts.predev: fkill --force --silent chatovo.exe chatovo; bun run icon
